# The Atlantic

> The Atlantic is a leading digital news and opinion platform covering politics, technology, science, culture, and global affairs with investigative reporting and expert commentary.

The Atlantic publishes daily coverage across major news categories including Trump administration politics, AI and technology ethics, climate science, international conflicts, and cultural criticism. The site features newsletters, opinion essays, photography galleries, and longform investigative projects alongside breaking news.

## Key Topics

- Trump administration
- National security
- Iran conflict
- AI and ChatGPT
- Climate change
- Immigration policy
- Vaccine policy
- Political commentary
- Renewable energy
- Middle East geopolitics
- Technology ethics
- Economic policy
- Investigative journalism
- Opinion essays
- Longform reporting

## News & Breaking Coverage

- [Homepage](https://www.theatlantic.com): The Atlantic homepage: news, politics, culture, technology, health coverage.
- [Latest](https://www.theatlantic.com/latest): Latest articles across politics, technology, health, and opinion.
- [Most Popular](https://www.theatlantic.com/most-popular): Most popular stories from The Atlantic curated daily.

## Politics & National Security

- [Politics](https://www.theatlantic.com/politics): Trump administration, elections, and political analysis coverage.
- [Global](https://www.theatlantic.com/international): International news: Iran conflict, Israel war, Middle East geopolitics.
- [Ideas](https://www.theatlantic.com/ideas): Opinion essays and political commentary on Trump, foreign policy, tech.

## Technology & Science

- [Technology](https://www.theatlantic.com/technology): AI, ChatGPT, OpenAI, deepfakes, and technology ethics coverage.
- [Science](https://www.theatlantic.com/science): Science news: climate change, renewable energy, environmental policy.
- [Planet](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects/planet): Climate change, renewable energy, environmental science hub.
- [Health](https://www.theatlantic.com/health): Health news: vaccine policy, disease outbreak, medical research coverage.

## Economy & Work

- [Economy](https://www.theatlantic.com/economy): Economy coverage: tariffs, housing, labor market, inflation analysis.
- [Work In Progress](https://www.theatlantic.com/progress): Economic analysis, job market, AI impact, wealth inequality coverage.

## Culture & Ideas

- [Culture](https://www.theatlantic.com/culture): Culture section: Oscars, entertainment, TV reviews, books, criticism.
- [Books](https://www.theatlantic.com/books): Book reviews, literary criticism, author profiles, reading lists.
- [Family](https://www.theatlantic.com/family): Family relationships, culture commentary, polyamory, women's history.

## Special Features & Subscriptions

- [Projects](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects): Editorial collections, longform journalism, investigative reporting hubs.
- [Photography](https://www.theatlantic.com/photo): Photography gallery, photojournalism, and visual storytelling features.
- [Newsletters](https://www.theatlantic.com/newsletters): Subscribe to Atlantic newsletters for daily news briefing and curated content.

## Optional

- [Education](https://www.theatlantic.com/education): Education policy, higher education, colleges, student accommodations.
